title: KMC simulation and wavelength extraction
action: Implement a Kinetic Monte Carlo simulation of a single [01] step on a square lattice (periodic x-boundary). Place an adatom source buffer of constant density c0 at a distance l ahead of the step; adjust the buffer position to keep the average step–buffer distance constant. Use an algorithm with diffusion of adatoms and melting/solidification at step edges according to the standard Metropolis-type probabilities. Run simulations for at least three distinct parameter sets (vary ε/kBT, c0, l) to vary the step stiffness and step velocity. For each set, measure the early-stage characteristic wavelength λ* (average step height around y=30, averaged over 50 independent runs) and late-stage λ* (y between 700 and 1000, averaged over 10 runs) by counting branches crossing a line at that height: λ* = L_x / N (L_x = 1024). Also compute the theoretical most unstable wavelength λmax from the linear stability analysis formula, using atomic area Ω=1, k_BT=1, and the anisotropic step stiffness for a [01] step. Output all results to a CSV file.
description: CSV containing the extracted early/late characteristic wavelengths, the theoretical λmax, and the underlying simulation parameters for each distinct parameter set.
output_schema: parameter_set: string identifier; epsilon_kBT: float; c0: float; l: float; beta_tilde_kBT: float; V0: float; lambda_early: float; lambda_late: float; lambda_max: float. At least three rows (three distinct parameter sets).
